crossRefs.note: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.
He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.
The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.
A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.
The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.
Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.
A stone is heavy, and sand is a burden; but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.
So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;
for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.
The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouth of fools gush out folly.

people.name: Saul

translations.web: Then Saul’s anger burned against Jonathan, and he said to him, “You son of a perverse rebellious woman, don’t I know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own shame, and to the shame of your mother’s nakedness?
translations.bsb: Then Saul’s anger burned against Jonathan, and he said to him, “You son of a perverse and rebellious woman! Do I not know that you have chosen the son of Jesse to your own shame and to the shame of the mother who bore you?
translations.kjv: Then Saul's anger was kindled against Jonathan, and he said unto him, Thou son of the perverse rebellious woman, do not I know that thou hast chosen the son of Jesse to thine own confusion, and unto the confusion of thy mother's nakedness?
